subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in not more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Summary Dr. Jamal Nazrul Islam is a great physicist of our country. He studied in the then West Pakistan, Calcutta University and Cambridge University. He got his doctorate in physics. He worked in the Institute of Theoretical Astronomy in Cambridge. He was a faculty member in King's College, London and City University, London. He did research work in the California Institute of Technology and Washington University. In 1971 he wrote to the Prime Minister of England to stop the Pakistani Army. He got Ekushey Padak in 2001 and Bangladesh Science Academy Gold Medal in 1985. Bangla Academy has published some of his popular science books.
